stats.reason: Deep-pass OCR consensus produced 2/3 false positives on spot-check (RAD-555 + SF-30 Pudge cases — Vision misread '150' and '180' as '158'). Even with strict 70%+ vote share, the OCR is unreliable enough on stylized BoBA art that auto-patching introduces more errors than it fixes. Manual review via manual_review.html is the safe path forward.
